events.summary: internal/audit/logger.go:85 MkdirAll(dir, 0750) and :91/:360 OpenFile(..., 0640), both with a why-comment (root hostPath read, group-readable is enough). internal/history/store.go:80 MkdirAll(dir, 0750) with a matching comment. internal/metrics/metrics.go:135 StartServer now builds an *http.Server{ReadTimeout:10s, ReadHeaderTimeout:10s, WriteTimeout:30s, IdleTimeout:120s} instead of calling http.ListenAndServe directly, mirroring internal/ui/server.go's existing *http.Server (confirmed via grep that internal/ui/server.go already uses *http.Server with all four timeouts set -- it was not a second bare-ListenAndServe site). 0640 still exceeds gosec's G302 ceiling of 0600, so a single narrowly-scoped, why-commented exclusion was added in .golangci.yml for internal/audit/logger.go's G302 only, documenting this as a reviewed exception rather than an unexamined default. No test asserted the old file modes (verified via grep before editing), so none needed updating. Added a CHANGELOG.md Unreleased/Bug Fixes entry for the permission change.
